items.question: How can I sign up for a new CareBridge account?

items.question: What are the steps to book a doctor appointment?

items.question: How does the clinic waitlist work?

items.question: Is the clinic open on Fridays?
items.ground_truth: No. The clinic is closed on Fridays and public holidays. Opening hours are Saturday to Thursday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Dhaka time).
reference_contexts:
# Opening hours and contact

## Hours

- **Saturday to Thursday:** 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Dhaka time).
- **Friday and public holidays:** closed.

Each doctor works on set days and times within these hours. The doctor list in **Book Appointment** shows each doctor's working days, and only their listed slots can be booked.

## Contact

- **Phone:** +880 1711-000000 (reception, during opening hours)
- **Address:** House 27, Road 9/A, Dhanmondi, Dhaka 1209

Reception staff speak Bangla and English.

## Getting here

- Only limited street parking is available.
- There is a wheelchair ramp and a lift at the entrance.

## Outside opening hours

You can still book, cancel, and reschedule in the app at any time. Reception confirms new bookings on the next working day. For emergencies, call 999 or go to the nearest hospital emergency department.

Hours can change around public holidays and during Ramadan. Call reception to check before you travel.

# Payment methods

## When you pay

items.question: Will I be charged if I cancel my visit?
items.ground_truth: No. There is no cancellation fee and no minimum notice period. Cancel from My Appointments (requested or confirmed) as early as you can so the slot can go to the waitlist.
reference_contexts:
# Cancellation policy

## How to cancel

Open **My Appointments** in the app and cancel the appointment. You can also ask the assistant. It prepares a cancellation card, and nothing changes until you press **Confirm** on that card.

## Which appointments can be cancelled

- Only appointments with status **requested** or **confirmed** can be cancelled.
- Completed appointments cannot be cancelled. Book a new follow-up appointment instead.
- Once cancelled, an appointment cannot be restored. Book again if you change your mind.

## Fees

There is no cancellation fee, and there is no minimum notice period. You can cancel at any time before the visit. Please cancel as early as you can so the slot can go to another patient.

## What happens to the freed slot

When you cancel, the slot is offered automatically to the next patient on the waitlist for that doctor and day.

## Cancelling for someone else

Each patient cancels from their own account. Reception staff can also cancel an appointment for you. Call +880 1711-000000 during opening hours.

items.question: How long do I have to accept a slot offered from the waitlist?
items.ground_truth: You have 120 minutes to accept a waitlist offer. The offer appears in My Appointments and under the bell icon; if you do not accept in time it expires.
reference_contexts:
# Waitlist

## When to use it

Join the waitlist when the day or slot you want with a doctor is fully booked. If the slot you want is free, book it directly instead.

## Rules for joining

- Choose today or a future date on one of the doctor's working days.
- You can name one taken slot, or leave the slot open to accept any time that day.
- You can have one open waitlist entry per doctor and day.

## Offers

When a matching appointment is cancelled or moved, the slot is offered to the next waiting patient. Patients who asked for that exact slot come first, then the earliest to join.

- You get a notification under the bell icon, and the offer appears in **My Appointments**.
- You have **120 minutes** to accept the offer.
- An accepted offer becomes a booking with status **requested**, which reception then confirms.
- If you decline, or do not accept in time, the slot passes to the next patient. You stay on the waitlist for other slots that day.

## Leaving

You can leave the waitlist at any time from My Appointments. Entries for dates that have passed close automatically.

items.question: Why do some doctors charge more than others?
items.ground_truth: Each doctor sets their own consultation fee; senior consultants charge more. Check the current fee on the doctor list in Book Appointment.
reference_contexts:
# Consultation fees

## How fees are set

Each doctor has their own consultation fee. Senior consultants charge more.

## Where to see a fee

- The doctor list in **Book Appointment** shows each doctor's fee, specialization, and working days.
- The booking summary shows the fee before you confirm.
- The assistant can look up a doctor's current fee for you.

Always check the current fee in the app. The fee shown there is the one that applies.

## Your bill

- Reception creates your bill after the visit.
- The bill total is built from the items on it, so it may include more than the consultation fee. Reception explains any extra item on request.
- You pay in cash at reception after the visit. Nothing is paid in advance.

items.question: Is my appointment confirmed as soon as I book it?
items.ground_truth: No. A new booking starts as requested until reception confirms it (usually the same or next working day). Confirmed status appears in My Appointments.
reference_contexts:
# Booking rules

## How to book

Open **Book Appointment** in the app. Choose a doctor, a date, and a time slot, and enter a short reason for the visit. The assistant can also prepare a booking card. Nothing is booked until you press **Confirm**.

## Rules

- You can only book one of the doctor's working days and one of their listed time slots.
- A slot that is already booked cannot be chosen. You can join the waitlist instead.
- Each patient books from their own account. Family members need their own accounts.
- You can book any future working day. There is no limit on how far ahead you book.

## Status

- **Requested**: reception has not confirmed the booking yet. Reception usually confirms it on the same or the next working day.
- **Confirmed**: shown in My Appointments. You get a reminder within the 24 hours before the visit.
- **Completed**: the consultation has taken place.

## Walk-ins

Walk-in patients are seen only if a slot is free. Booking in the app is preferred.

## On the day

- Bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports.
- If you arrive more than 15 minutes late, you may need to reschedule.

# Refund policy

## No advance payment

You do not pay when you book. Payment is made at reception after your visit, once your bill has been created. Because nothing is paid in advance, cancelling or rescheduling never costs you anything and there is nothing to refund.

## No refund process

The clinic does not have a refund process for completed consultations.

## If you think your bill is wrong

- Check your bill in the app. The assistant can show it to you.
- Contact reception on +880 1711-000000 during opening hours, or ask at the front desk on your next visit.
- Do not pay a bill you believe is wrong until reception has checked it.
- If you paid twice or were charged in error, reception checks the bill and returns the extra amount in cash.

# Payment methods

## When you pay

You pay after your visit, not in advance. Reception creates your bill once the consultation is completed. There is one bill per appointment.

## Where you pay

## Accepted methods

- **Cash**: available.
- **Card**: not available at present.
- **Mobile banking**: not available at present.

Please pay in cash until card and mobile banking payments become available.

## Bill status

- **Unpaid**: the bill has not been paid yet.
- **Paid**: reception has recorded your payment.

## Insurance
